long_biography.plain_text:
Pickering left formal education after Year 10 and moved through jobs collecting rags and training as a butcher before turning a childhood fascination with cars into a profession. He created a dealer network along the Gold Coast and NSW border, adding new-vehicle franchises, used inventory, servicing, parts and tailored finance.

Pickering also served as managing director of South Coast Automotive Group and Finance EZI, a national finance facilitator. Racing became both a personal pursuit and a marketing platform: he competed, entered touring cars and sponsored emerging drivers. His teams fielded machinery in development categories and Carrera Cup, while the dealership group broadened into luxury marques and customer motoring events.
